title: Super Wonder Boy in Monster Land

records.c: First of 15 rows in the captured stage descriptor, each 96 bytes. The row-pointer table also contains later entries, and some runtime consumers do not locally bound their indexes.
Read by the eight-page stage-four character copy from $a0f8–$a8f7. It is not a fifth price digit: the price writer at $a807–$a83c and reader at $a7ec–$a7fb both bound the price buffer to four bytes.
